messages:
alyssa: Heads up — trying to roll out a terraform change to create ephemeral GPU nodepools in eu-west for a model-canary. Hitting a couple of things: cluster-autoscaler flapping when spot capacity drops, and intermittent ENI quota errors during scale-up.

jon: Can you paste the TF resource that creates the launch template / node group? esp. the mixed_instances_policy + tags.

alyssa: Here's the simplified TF snippet:
```
resource "aws_launch_template" "gpu_lt" {
  name_prefix = "gpu-lt-canary-"
  image_id = var.ami
  instance_type = ""
  instance_market_options {
    market_type = "spot"
  }
  user_data = base64encode(templatefile("launch.sh", { kubelet_opts = "--node-labels=ec2-type=gpu" }))
}

module "node_group" {
  source = "git::ssh://git@.../terraform-aws-eks//modules/node_group"
  name = "canary-gpu"
  mixed_instance_policy = true
  overrides = ["p4d.24xlarge", "p3dn.24xlarge"]
  tags = {
    "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/enabled" = "true"
    "k8s.io/cluster-autoscaler/${var.cluster_name}" = "owned"
  }
}
```

mike: A couple of things — CA needs to see autoscalingGroup tags on the ASG not just LT or module tags. Also try setting balance-similar-node-groups: true in the helm chart and increase scaleDownUnneededTime to 10m. Example helm values:
```
autoscaler:
  extraArgs:
    --balance-similar-node-groups=true
    --scale-down-unneeded-time=10m
    --skip-nodes-with-local-storage=false
```

sara: ENI quota is real in eu-west AZs — if you mix p4/p3 you may run out of ENIs fast. Check `aws ec2 describe-instance-types` for max ENIs/max pods. Quick workaround: reduce maxPodsPerNode or enable prefix-delegation. You can patch the kubelet config via nodegroup user_data: `--max-pods=32` or set aws-node ipam config.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: helm upgrade --install cluster-autoscaler infra/cluster-autoscaler --namespace kube-system — succeeded (staging) at 2045678925

jon: For cost control, consider fallback pools of cheaper GPU (or even CPU) and set CA expander to least-waste. Also use `--nodes=0:3:canary-gpu` to limit burst. If spot drops, CA should prefer fallback group.

alyssa: Found the issue — our TF module was tagging the LT resource name not the ASG created by nodegroup. Fixing module to attach tags to autoscaling_group resource. Quick workaround I applied to CA: added `--skip-nodes-with-system-pods=false` and `--scan-interval=20s` to speed detection.

sara: After fix, we saw scale-up succeed but one AZ still hit ENI quota — moving some of the GPU ASGs to other AZs and enabling warm-pool for p3 to reduce churn.

alyssa: Plan: PR to terraform module to set tags on ASG + adjust launch template to set max-pods and ENI-friendly cni config, helm values change + increase scaleDownUnneededTime. Will run canary for 6 hours and monitor conntrack/ENI metrics. :thumbsup:
